nodes.label: Snipset research mode as a five-layer opt-in gate
nodes.norm_label: snipset research mode as a five layer opt in gate
nodes.summary: Research mode is an opt-in switch for customer-support research, default OFF, and the note describes it as five layers: the global toggle (preferences.key research_mode_enabled, infallible read that treats a failed read as false), the groups.research_tag column, expansion logging through effective_support_context(), the gated data joins (link_expansion_ticket, submit_csat_response, get_csat_summary, all refusing with RESEARCH_MODE_DISABLED), and the export plus ResearchStatisticsTab UI that shows only a notice while the mode is off.

nodes.label: Keyword-first then group-tag escalation in effective_support_context
nodes.norm_label: keyword first then group tag support context escalation
nodes.summary: analytics_v2/helpers.rs:76-88 effective_support_context() decides support context in three steps: a keyword hit from infer_support_context returns true outright, otherwise research_mode=on plus a tagged group_id upgrades it to true, otherwise false. The consequence stated in the note is that /jadwal, /refund and LMS expansions from a tagged group enter the tagged cohort with no keyword in the snippet text at all.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-10-01 - cara-kerja-fitur-research [ses_f0a431a9effeUP5wA3Yv7NuuG5].md:L3650] The keyword check runs first so existing snippets keep counting without a group tag

nodes.label: Research export carries metadata and hashes only, asserted by a no-PII test
nodes.norm_label: research export carries metadata and hashes only asserted by a no pii test
nodes.summary: The export path get_research_export -> research_export_rows_with_conn() aggregates per day across the tagged/untagged cohorts (expansions, chars_inserted, est_time_saved_sec, successes/failures, avg_latency_ms, distinct_sources, cumulative_*) and emits {days, active_days, json, csv}. The privacy invariant is enforced by test_get_research_export_aggregates_and_no_pii, which asserts that refund, ticket #99 and the snippet body do not appear in either output.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-10-01 - cara-kerja-fitur-research [ses_f0a431a9effeUP5wA3Yv7NuuG5].md:L3657] Source ids are SHA256-hashed so the raw ticket number and snippet uuid are never stored

nodes.label: groups.research_tag existed with no command or UI able to set it
nodes.norm_label: groups research tag existed with no command or ui able to set it
nodes.summary: The column was in schema.rs:36 and defaulted to 0, but nothing in the app could write research_tag=1: the only writers were the tests at history.rs:414 and schema_tests.rs:481. A Customer Support group therefore still landed in the tagged cohort through the keyword path rather than through its own tag, and the only available route was quitting Snipset, backing up snipset.db and running UPDATE groups SET research_tag=1 by hand.

nodes.label: A serde-defaulted struct field plus every SELECT threads an additive column through Rust and SQL
nodes.norm_label: a serde defaulted struct field plus every select threads an additive column through rust and sql
nodes.summary: The RED step for the new flag failed to compile rather than to assert: 'unknown field research_tag' and 'no field research_tag on type group::Group' (E0560, E0609) in group_tests.rs:144. The fix was to add #[serde(default)] pub research_tag: bool to the Group struct, add research_tag: false to every struct literal, and widen each SELECT and its row.get indices in groups.rs.

nodes.label: Per-group research tag shipped as a GroupModal checkbox and a Riset sidebar badge
nodes.norm_label: per group research tag shipped as a groupmodal checkbox and a riset sidebar badge
nodes.summary: Four tasks closed the gap: Group.research_tag in the struct with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE, set_research_tag_cmd and get_research_tagged_groups with an explicit error on an unknown uuid, the checkbox plus the Riset badge with en/id keys (groupResearchTag/Hint/Badge), and the audit doc with its gates. Green evidence: nextest group_tests 4/4, group_cmds 2/2, schema_tests 28, history 5, stats_cmds 19, clippy 0 warnings on vps-bcb, and Vitest GroupModal 7/7, Sidebar 10/10, researchKeys 32, completeness 24. Bulk-tag from the Research tab and auto-tagging the Customer Support group stayed in the backlog because they need their own plan and approval.

nodes.label: Snipset binaries store the frontend opaquely, so strings cannot find UI text
nodes.norm_label: snipset binaries store the frontend opaquely so strings cannot find ui text
nodes.summary: A probe of the installed binary for 'ResearchStatisticsTab' and 'Tandai sebagai grup riset' returned zero hits, which was read at first as a frontend that had fallen behind. The note withdraws that claim: every Snipset binary, including the healthy 0.6.853, stores the frontend opaquely, so strings is not a probe for UI text at all, while the same index-B9jOOarm.js in the VPS dist does contain the new key.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-10-01 - cara-kerja-fitur-research [ses_f0a431a9effeUP5wA3Yv7NuuG5].md:L14476] The stale-frontend charge was withdrawn after the healthy 0.6.853 binary failed the same strings probe

nodes.label: stdio inherited from a dead tool session panics the app with a broken pipe
nodes.norm_label: stdio inherited from a dead tool session panics the app with a broken pipe
nodes.summary: The 12:31 launch died with 'failed printing to stderr: broken pipe' as a ROOT FATAL PANIC, and the note attributes it to its own launch method: the stdio stayed attached to a tool session that had already ended. The same binary launched with stdio redirected to a file ran clean, which separates the failure from the build.

nodes.label: A binary swap requires backups and a tray-quit before the app is touched
nodes.norm_label: a binary swap requires backups and a tray quit before the app is touched
nodes.summary: Before swapping in 0.6.854 the note took three .bak-*-20261001-122859 copies so the rollback to 0.6.853 is a one-minute copy-back, then stopped with the swap itself: the app was still running at PID 557610 and the runbook forbids swapping under a live app. The only step left for the human was quitting from the tray, after which the sequence is swap, verify, relaunch and a three-layer window check.
